evaluator: Codex visual inspection of actual tool output and six canonical assets, 2026-10-26

linework.observation: Watch outlines are visible but material scratches and dense wood marks dominate over simple contour construction.

colour.observation: Muted brass brown and cool grey lighting remain naturalistic.

shading.observation: Reflective chain highlights and dense brass tonal modelling exceed simplified bands of object reference.

backgrounds.observation: Wood microtexture and softened station background depart from crisp outlined environment.

finish.observation: Scratched metal and photographic wood detail are materially more realistic than canonical object reference.

identity.observation: Object-only scene with no shared protagonist.

content.observation: Extra tools and oil can occupy a bench requested to be otherwise empty.

composition.observation: Watch and complete short chain fit within wide frame.

regions.foreground_props: Watch has realistic fine scratches and reflective link highlights.
regions.architecture: Window and distant station are overly soft.
regions.distance: Station silhouette loses crisp reference-style contours.
regions.lighting: Cool daylight is appropriate; material response is too realistic.

correction: Remove all scratches, grain and microtexture. Draw the watch as simple smooth brass fill plus one flat shadow and one broad illustrated highlight band; draw chain links as simple outlined loops without specular dots. Workbench must be a plain flat brown shape with at most three seam lines. Remove every tool, jar, oil can and other prop: only closed watch and chain. Keep all outlines crisp; no blurred station view. Match the flat phone casing and simplified saucepan bands in reference, not photographic brass.
